div.head: Cn 1018
div.ab: And witena gerædnes is þæt man rihte laga upp arǽre. And æghwilce unlaga georne afille. And þæt man awéodige. 7 awyrtwalige. æghwilc unriht. swa man geornost mæge. of þisan earde. 7 arære up godes riht.

And the decree of the councillors is that just laws be promoted, and every misdeed be zealously suppressed, and that every wrong be extirpated and eradicated from this earth, as may most zealously be done, and the justice of God be promoted.
